**sdd/issue-231-a2/proposal**

A2 (#231) — GitLab Governance Pipeline. Ships: (B1) brain/scripts/ci/gitlab-governance.yml eight-job fragment, consumer opts in via `include: local:`; added to managed-paths as literal, consumer root .gitlab-ci.yml never managed. (B2) THE GOTCHA: GitLab has no CI_MERGE_REQUEST_DESCRIPTION and CI_MERGE_REQUEST_LABELS freezes at pipeline creation, so issue-link/diff-size cannot be bash — extend run-check.mjs with issue-link+diff-size cases feeding the EXISTING pure evaluators from loadContext(); all 8 GitLab jobs route through Node. (B3) governance.approvedLabel additive config-migrations entry, provider-resolved (status:approved GitHub, status::approved GitLab), replaces 3 hardcoded reads (governance.yml:78, actor-check.mjs:150, brain-start.mjs:67) — TOUCHES brain/core/config-migrations.mjs → L6 brain-writes-reviewed gate. (B4) REQUIRED=normal jobs fail-closed, DETECTION=allow_failure:true (Amendment 3); never flatten. (B5) drift-guard extension parses GitLab YAML by string-slice (no yaml npm dep), asserts job-set==GOVERNANCE_JOBS + allow_failure iff DETECTION. PLAN-DEVIATION: A2 ships ALONE (plan's A2+A3 coupling assumed demo needs provider verbs — it needs only ci-context+pipeline; prView/mrCreate stay A3 stubs). CP-A2 SPLIT: CP-A2a = fixture-tested code (acceptance for this slice, hard stop, PR-as-review); CP-A2b = live e2e DEFERRED until GitLab access+endpoint restored. Full artifact at openspec/changes/issue-231-a2/proposal.md.
